row.notes: myteam-g2: Evaluates a facility perk node effect: reads an input stat via FUN_140f88c60, maps (value - node+0x15c) * node+0x158 into [0,1], interpolates the 64-entry byte LUT at node+0x174 scaled by node+0x160/+0x16c (or node+0x164 at 1.0), then clamps by the min/max of the team attribute found via node+0x18 team key / node+0xa8 attribute id. Called by Career_Tick_FacilityNodes and the workforce view; hook: the LUT bytes at node+0x174 define perk strength. CORRECTION(V9018): Curve part verified: input FUN_140f88c60, (v-node+0x15c)*node+0x158 clamped to [0,1], 64-entry byte LUT at +0x174 linearly interpolated with scale +0x160 and offset +0x16c (+0x164 at exactly 1.0). Correction: the team attribute (node+0x20 set, team key node+0x18, id node+0xa8) is not used to clamp the result; its clamped value (attr+0x7c, 1.0 if missing) multiplies the curve value before conversion to int.
